description: This file is a shell script containing a collection of tests for Git's fsck (file system consistency check) functionality. It includes setup routines, various test cases for repository integrity, object validation, and corruption detection, as well as utility functions for manipulating Git objects during the tests.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Computes the file path of a Git object based on its SHA1 hash.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Removes a Git object file based on its hash to simulate corruption or missing objects.

methods.name: corrupt_index_checksum
methods.description: A Perl subroutine that manipulates the Git index checksum to simulate index corruption.

methods.name: create_repo_missing
methods.description: Creates a repository missing a specified object, used to test fsck's detection of missing objects.

methods.name: corrupt_graph_obj
methods.description: Corrupts a commit-graph object in a repo to test fsck behavior with faulty per-commit graph data.
